scope.target_service: General Windows Server service scan: IIS/HTTP.sys/Web Deploy/WSUS, SMB/DCERPC/RDP/WinRM/MSMQ/LDAP/Kerberos/DNS, database services, SSH/FTP/mail services, TLS, and third-party server applications when fingerprinted.
scope.module_policy: Generated from 1643 source rows. Keeps runnable service-facing Metasploit modules and excludes documentation/data/external source, local privilege escalation, post-exploitation, client-side browser/fileformat/email modules, mobile modules, and DoS modules by default. Exploit modules are check-only.
scope.execution_mode: local USB audit: msfrpc safe auxiliary run/check plus PowerShell service/patch posture checks
notes: Source rows: 1643; actual runnable module paths under modules/: 826; included service-facing modules: 592; excluded/non-runner rows: 1051.
Auxiliary scanner/gather/admin modules may be run with safe datastore defaults.
Exploit modules must be invoked with Metasploit check only; never execute exploit/payload in the default audit workflow.
DoS modules are intentionally excluded from the default service scan profile.
Third-party web/service modules remain in the profile, but the runner should execute them only after fingerprinting the service/product to avoid noisy false positives.
